geography.method: WGS84 ellipsoidal polygon area, coordinate-linear densification ≤0.1 degree; Natural Earth 1:50m land removed consistently. Study domain is Section 2.2 PDF7 fixed rectangle, distinct from warm-pool Figure1 PDF3. Approximate due SAU repaired high-seas polygon, coarse land, and published-area disagreement.
geography.source_confirmation: Current selected PDF7 Section 2.2 and PDF3 Figure 1 text inspected. Fixed 110-180E,15N-15S domain and reported 26.964 million km2 confirmed. Figure 1 is warm-pool/cold-tongue context rather than the exact GIS polygon.
geography.interpretation: A is overlap/HS_071. B is overlap/study. The range expresses alternative domain denominator and boundary uncertainty, not a statistical interval. Substantial HS_071 area lies outside the fixed pelagic model rectangle; spatial overlap does not establish catch composition.
geography.asset_note: region_boundary.png and study_domain.png are byte-identical overlays showing both region and model rectangle. Their identical extent is intentional in the retained builder; original article Figure 1 is the separate crop. All inspected assets are readable.
